text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bosnian Prime Minister Hasan Muratovic leaves Kuwait after official visit.
- Burgan Bank says it plans to enter Asian markets to finance oil deals.

- Qatar's emir says willing to visit Manama to invite Bahrain's emir to Gulf summit. Bahrain has said it will not attend the summit in Qatar which has taken a territorial dispute with the island state to the International Court of Justice. Bahrain wants a Gulf Arab solution to the dispute with Qatar.
- Active trade at the Kuwait Stock Exchange in the week to Wednesday, bank report says.
- Finance Minister Nasser al-Rodhan says state encourages private sector to provide entertainment services.
- Kuwait Stock Exchange index falls 15 points to 1891.4 points on Sunday.
- Kuwait's Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah to attend Sunday's Gulf summit in Qatar.
- MPs discuss labour law, want single expatriates out of Kuwaiti residential areas.
